decision_rule: Require all 63 valid requests across 7 ordered fresh-server arms, 3 prompts and 3 repetitions; otherwise INCOMPLETE. For each factor and prompt separately, take median of 3 acceptance ratios and of 3 client stream-event rates for intervention and each adjacent baseline; label outside-observed-baseline only if intervention median is strictly below both or strictly above both adjacent baseline medians, else within-observed-baseline. Report all medians and raw repetitions, no p-value, causal or generalization claim; missing, ambiguous, nonresident or window-only acceptance association remains UNKNOWN for response-ID attribution. V10 reproduction, not historical binary identity. Native post-hook comparison rederives original SSE, raw acceptance and timed residency; response-ID attribution UNKNOWN. Smoke is one baseline request only, separate allocator result and SMOKE_COMPLETE, never full-sweep evidence.
